patterns.reminder: The Supabase secret key (sb_secret_…, the old service_role) must not go into client code; it bypasses RLS. Move it to the server side (server action, route handler, edge function).
NEXT_PUBLIC_ / EXPO_PUBLIC_ variables are embedded in the browser and the app bundle. Never define a secret value with this prefix.
Do not log personal data or credentials (GDPR, KVKK or the local data protection law). Mask the identity or log only the record id.
